menu.title: Ninja Grip
menu.hint: On phone: Play opens landscape fullscreen. Tap anywhere to aim+fire. Swipe up (or Jump) to detach. Tilt to swing / rope.

help.subtitle: Ninja guide
help.title: How to play?
help.aimBody: Desktop: mouse aim + Space. Phone: tap or drag anywhere to aim, release to shoot.
help.fireBody: Desktop: Shift. Phone: swipe up, or press the Jump button.
help.swingBody: Desktop: A/D move, W/S or ↑/↓ for rope length and ladder climb (same keys — you can't do both at once). Phone: tilt sideways to swing, tilt forward/back for vertical.
help.restBody: Stand on platforms or hang from handles to aim safely. Target color = strength (how long it holds); size is separate — big red and small green both happen.
help.scrollBody: The camera stays still until you pass mid-screen. After that it drifts right — red edges warn you; leave the frame and it's game over.

display.rotateBody: Hold the phone sideways (landscape). Play uses fullscreen so browser bars stay out of the way.

battle.loseMsg: Try again — earn coins in the main run.

hideSeek.subtitle: Find them all before time runs out
hideSeek.title: Ninja Hide & Seek
hideSeek.instructions:
You are the seeker — find 9 hiding ninjas.
D-pad to move • 🔫 to shoot
Hit a ninja = found!
You have 60 seconds and 12 bullets.
